If you want a pocket-friendly device without the upkeep, Orange Dream Refresher Foger Switch Pro Disposable is built for exactly that. Foger pairs a pre-filled pod with a built-in battery so you can focus on flavor — here, tangy citrus brightness with a soft sweet finish.

Orange Dream Refresher Foger Switch Pro Disposable is listed at $13.99 in our Disposable Vapes range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Disposable Vapes](/shop/disposables/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name Orange Dream Refresher Switch points to tangy citrus brightness with a soft sweet finish. Taste is subjective, and the same flavor can read sweeter or sharper depending on the device and your own palate, so use this as a starting point.

- **Brand:** Foger

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Large pre-filled capacity:** means fewer replacements and less packaging, which suits adults who vape through the day.
- **Built-in battery:** removes the need for separate cells or chargers, which keeps the device compact enough for a pocket or bag.
- **Mesh-style coil technology:** helps spread heat evenly across the coil, which supports consistent flavor through the life of the device.
- **Draw-activated firing:** there are no buttons to learn, so it starts when you inhale and stops when you do.

### About the strength
This product is listed at 50mg (5%). Compare that figure with what you currently use before you order, remember that nicotine is addictive, and speak to a healthcare professional if you have questions about it.

## Who it suits
Orange Dream Refresher Foger Switch Pro Disposable suits adult nicotine users who want a simple, ready-to-use device, travelers who prefer something that fits in a pocket, and anyone trying a new flavor before committing to a larger setup.

## Using and caring for it
Use the device only as directed on the packaging. Take gentle, short puffs rather than long, hard draws, which helps the coil keep up and avoids a burnt taste. Keep it upright when you are not using it, store it at room temperature away from direct sunlight and hot cars, and do not try to open, refill or modify it. When the flavor fades or the battery stops responding, dispose of it according to local rules for electronics and batteries. Keep it away from children and pets.
